title: Inspiration: Its Nature and Extent
author: Edward Hoare

authorInfo.bio: Edward Hoare (1812–1894) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Inspiration: Its Nature and Extent" by Edward Hoare is a theological treatise written in the late 19th century. This book explores the complex relationship between the divine and human elements of scriptural inspiration, aiming to clarify the concept of inspiration as it pertains to the Bible.
